🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (10/11) but extreme leadership concentration in Technology (Top 5 = AMD, QCOM, LRCX, INTC, ORCL) and a major divergence among large caps (MSFT, NVDA, META in CORRECTION) — mixed signals justify NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt; Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: AMD (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +14.43% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND, BA (1W: +2.60% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing lift: EL (1W: +14.51% | 1M: +25.30%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy lagging: XOM (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -9.29%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -3.67% | 1M: -8.13%) BELOW TREND. Communication showing cracks with big-cap pullbacks: META (1W: -8.41% | 1M: +6.58%) CORRECTION. Healthcare mixed with pockets of weakness: ABT (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -14.72%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +19.35%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +23.44% | 1M: +55.21%) ABOVE TREND; LRCX (1W: +19.47% | 1M: +32.46%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +19.27% | 1M: +113.59%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ABT (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -14.72%) BELOW TREND; VLO (1W: -5.81% | 1M: -5.88%) BELOW TREND; UPS (1W: -6.30% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION; MA (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND; SYK (1W: -7.24% | 1M: -11.97%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Energy and select Industrials/Healthcare.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: AMD (1W: +25.00%), QCOM (1W: +23.44%), LRCX (1W: +19.47%), INTC (1W: +19.27%), ORCL (1W: +18.43%). Watch for major divergence risk: MSFT (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +11.19%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +16.69%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -8.41% | 1M: +6.58%) CORRECTION — tactical uncertainty.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: Semiconductors and select software names rally hard (AMD (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) ABOVE TREND; QCOM (1W: +23.44% | 1M: +55.21%) ABOVE TREND) while megacaps show short‑term pullbacks (MSFT (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +11.19%) CORRECTION; NVDA (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +16.69%) CORRECTION). Technology is a driver of breadth but leadership is narrow — monitor follow‑through.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed but not weak: JPM (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +5.88%) ABOVE TREND while MA (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND and V (1W: -4.80% | 1M: +5.37%) CORRECTION signal dispersion; Financials contributing to overall breadth but watch payments/news flow.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Patchy: LLY (1W: +15.96% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND on FDA/earnings catalyst, while ABT (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -14.72%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -1.20% | 1M: -5.78%) BELOW TREND show defensive unevenness; sector breadth modestly positive but mixed internals.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to leading semiconductors and AI‑infrastructure names (AMD, QCOM, ORCL) while reducing exposure to lagging Energy and structurally challenged payments names (MA, V) until trend stability returns; style: Growth/Momentum tilt but manage risk given narrow leadership and major-cap divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) ABOVE TREND; ORCL (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND; LLY (1W: +15.96% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: MA (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND; V (1W: -4.80% | 1M: +5.37%) CORRECTION; XOM (1W: -3.87% | 1M: -9.29%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (semis/software leadership); Industrials (cyclicals like CAT). BEARISH: Energy (continued pressure); Payments/Select Financials (news‑sensitive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +16.69%) CORRECTION—hold recent 1W lows for resumption; AAPL (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +13.42%) ABOVE TREND—sustain >1W gains to stay constructive; ORCL (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND—confirmments on AI deal follow‑through; MA (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND—watch for continuation below short‑term support.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+85): Eli Lilly (1W: +15.96% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND after Foundayo approval and strong revenue — price confirms sentiment. ORCL (+65): Oracle (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND after OpenAI‑linked deals — sentiment and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (-45): Mastercard (1W: -6.35% | 1M: -1.11%) BELOW TREND amid UK FCA probe headlines — sentiment confirmed by price weakness. V (-45): Visa (1W: -4.80% | 1M: +5.37%) CORRECTION on same probe news — negative sentiment versus mixed medium‑term trend, watch for follow‑through.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Growth/Momentum tilt given narrow tech leadership and broad sector participation. AMD (1W: +25.00% | 1M: +90.22%) ABOVE TREND and ORCL (1W: +18.43% | 1M: +36.00%) ABOVE TREND are showing clear strength. Key risk is major‑cap divergence — MSFT (1W: -2.47% | 1M: +11.19%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -0.68% | 1M: +16.69%) CORRECTION and META (1W: -8.41% | 1M: +6.58%) CORRECTION — monitor sentiment and leadership breadth for confirmation.
